description: Searches Datacircle's sheet of API plans and gives the ones that match, best first unless you sort them. Call list_apis first for the APIs' names, then pass one as api for that API's plans; leave api out to search every API at once. Add query to find a provider or a plan by name, and sort by price for the cheapest first. Each plan holds every key of the sheet's JSON download: its provider, plan, billing, $ per 1,000 (perThousand), score out of 100 (score), rate limits, speed, the fields it returns and its page on datacircle.dev (page). What each key means: https://datacircle.dev/fields. With api, the answer links the API's sheet (sheetPage) and its best page (bestPage), which ranks its providers on our benchmark. total counts every plan found, and plans holds up to limit of them (10 unless you say, at most 50) from offset: page through the rest with offset. When no plan matches, you get total 0 and an empty plans list, not an error; an argument its schema doesn't allow, like an api list_apis doesn't give, is an error that says what it takes. Free, no key, read-only.

api.description: The API, its name as list_apis gives it. Every API when left out.

limit.description: How many plans to give, 1 to 50. 10 when left out.

offset.description: How many found plans to skip first. 0 when left out.

query.description: Words that must all appear in the provider's name and the plan's name read together, ignoring case and accents: "scrappa free" finds Scrappa's Free plans.

sort.description: score, the default: best first, as on the sheet at datacircle.dev, each API's plans together, unscored plans last. provider: A to Z. price: $ per 1,000, lowest first.

name: search_plans

bestPage.description: The API's best page on datacircle.dev, which ranks its providers on our benchmark. Left out where it has none. Only when api is given.

offset.description: How many found plans were skipped first.

plans.description: Up to limit of the plans found, from offset. Empty when none matches.

items.description: One plan of one call: a row of the sheet's JSON download, every key, with its page. What each key means: https://datacircle.dev/fields

api.description: The plan's API, its name as list_apis gives it.

billing.description: How you pay, like free, on-demand, monthly, one-time or contact.

page.description: The plan's own page on datacircle.dev.

perThousand.description: Dollars for 1,000 items on this plan, 0 on a free plan. Null where the plan has no such price.

plan.description: The plan's name on the provider's pricing page.

score.description: The plan's score out of 100. Null on a plan we don't score.

sheetPage.description: The API's sheet on datacircle.dev: its plans and their prices. Only when api is given.

total.description: How many plans match, on every page of them. 0 when none does.

title: Search the API plans
